name: Born Again Believers
overview: Scripture reveals that being a born again believer is essential for entering and seeing the kingdom of God, as Jesus teaches Nicodemus that one must be born of water and the Spirit to enter the kingdom (John 3:3, 5). This new birth is a spiritual transformation made possible through faith in Jesus Christ, who was given by God out of love so that believers might have eternal life (John 3:16). Confession of Jesus as Lord and belief in His resurrection are the means by which one is saved, marking the beginning of this new spiritual life (Romans 10:9).
